entities.name: St. Paul and Peter Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Saint Paul and Peter Church was an Armenian Apostolic church in Yerevan, Armenia originally built during the 5th-6th centuries. It was demolished in November 1930 to make room for the Moscow Cinema on Abovyan Street.
